summary: New accounts receive $10 in free credits, or $20 with a work email. The free signup grant does not require a card. One shared balance covers Search, Answer, Contents and DeepResearch; official documentation says the free trial includes every source. After the trial, specialised datasets have plan-dependent access, pay-as-you-go top-ups have a $10 minimum, and overage is billed at the applicable plan rates. No enrollment deadline or free-grant validity duration is stated in the loaded pages.
claim_steps: Sign up for a new Valyu account; use a work email for the officially stated $20 grant instead of $10.
Use the free balance to try the APIs and source catalog; no card is required for the signup grant.
